title: Dev push: dev bundles and image manifests (docs/DEV-PUSH.md 5, 8)
description: A dev bundle is an .ipk (ar: debian-binary, control.tar.gz with ./control and ./devpush.json, data.tar.gz with the files at their device paths, regular files of mode 0644 or 0755) and beside it <bundle>.ipk.sig: base64 of the Ed25519 signature of the .ipk's exact bytes, then a newline (the detached form of feeds.schema.json), by the key devpush.json names in "by". The paths a bundle may change and the size caps: apps/shared/platform/src/devpush-paths.json. The reader every side follows: apps/shared/platform/src/devpush.js (checkManifest, verify); the maker: tools/nova. An image's manifest is /usr/share/phoenix/manifest.json, written by tools/install-rootfs.py --manifest and stamped at image time (--stamp). New optional fields may be added inside a format; none may be removed or changed.

path.description: An absolute device path inside one of the overlay's directories (/usr/share/phoenix, /usr/palm, /usr/lib/luna, /usr/share/luna-service2, /etc/palm), no "." or ".." segment, not one of the refused paths (devpush-paths.json)

productLine.description: The product line, product.json's major version: "1.0" (webos-phoenix) or "2.0" (phoenix-ember-glass-ui). 2.0 devices take no 1.0 bundles

source.description: The checkout it was made from, when it is a git checkout

id.description: The first 32 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the rest of devpush.json (keys sorted)

compatible.description: RAUC's compatible of the device type it is for; null: any device of that build

device.description: The device's id, or "any" (never for a granted developer key)

counter.description: Above the last one the device applied for the same grant (or key): no replay (DEV-PUSH.md 9.1). nova uses the time it was made, in milliseconds

mode.description: replace: the overlay ends up holding exactly these files; add: they are added to what it holds

parts.description: The parts its paths are in, sorted (devpush-paths.json "parts"); a grant names the parts it allows

restart.description: What its maker expects restarted (DEV-PUSH.md 4.5); the device works it out itself

imageManifest.description: An image's /usr/share/phoenix/manifest.json (format 1): every file Phoenix ships that a dev bundle may change, sorted by path. GET v1/builds/{buildId}/manifest.json serves the same (DEV-PUSH.md 7.2, P4)
